name: echovote
description: Transparent feedback democracy platform: Express + Supabase backend, Next.js frontend

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
